method.en: We collected 3,704 X posts with twitterapi.io: hourly and daily keyword searches from 27 Aug to 25 Sep 2026, the timelines of about 50 involved accounts, replies and quotes under 67 key threads and searches in 17 other languages, plus posts from earlier research. 2,701 of them relate to the event (2,440 name HIMS or BONER or sit in those threads); we picked 39, paraphrased each in our own words with a link to the original, and checked the figures they cite against the on-chain replay.
method.zh: 我們透過 twitterapi.io 收集了 3,704 則 X 貼文：2026 年 8 月 27 日至 9 月 25 日依小時與日切片的關鍵字搜尋、約 50 個相關帳號的時間軸、67 個重要串文底下的回覆與引用，以及另外 17 種語言的搜尋，再加上先前研究已有的貼文。其中 2,701 則與事件相關（2,440 則提到 HIMS 或 BONER，或位於上述串文中）；我們挑出 39 則，以自己的話轉述並附上原文連結，並把貼文引用的數字拿去和鏈上重播比對。

hourlyDef.en: Posts per hour that name HIMS or BONER, or reply inside the expanded threads, 28 Aug 18:00 to 31 Aug 14:00 UTC.
hourlyDef.zh: 每小時提到 HIMS 或 BONER、或位於已展開串文內的貼文數，範圍為 8 月 28 日 18:00 至 8 月 31 日 14:00 UTC。

paraphrase.en: BONER's own account says its pool and vault hold more than 8,000 HIMS tokens, which it calls over half of all HIMS on Robinhood Chain.
paraphrase.zh: BONER 官方帳號表示，它的流動性池與金庫合計持有超過 8,000 顆 HIMS，佔 Robinhood Chain 上所有 HIMS 的一半以上。

what.en: BONER pool share of on-chain HIMS
what.zh: BONER 池佔鏈上 HIMS 的比例

note.en: Pool principal alone is just over half. The 8,000+ also counts the project vault, which the replay does not track.
note.zh: 光是池內本金就略高於一半；8,000 顆以上還包括專案金庫，重播資料沒有追蹤金庫。

paraphrase.en: A day earlier, a thought experiment: a memecoin paired with tokenized NVIDIA could soak up the chain's small NVDA supply, and weekends, when no new tokens can be minted, would expose it first.
paraphrase.zh: 事件前一天的推演：與代幣化 NVIDIA 配對的迷因幣，可能把鏈上本來就不多的 NVDA 吸光；週末無法增發時，這個缺口最先暴露。

paraphrase.en: Pitches BONER as a way to squeeze HIMS shorts, noting HIMS is among the most shorted NYSE stocks and that BONER already holds about half of all tokenized HIMS.
paraphrase.zh: 把 BONER 包裝成軋 HIMS 空頭的工具，說 HIMS 是紐約證交所空單比例最高的股票之一，而 BONER 已持有約一半的代幣化 HIMS。

what.en: BONER pool share of on-chain HIMS
what.zh: BONER 池佔鏈上 HIMS 的比例

note.en: Matches Sunday midday, ten hours before the buying wave.
note.zh: 與週日中午的數字相符，當時距離買盤湧入還有十小時。

paraphrase.en: Warns people not to launch or buy stock-paired memes outside market hours until market makers can handle weekends, pointing to on-chain AMC at 35x its real price.
paraphrase.zh: 警告在造市商能應付週末之前，別在休市時段發行或追買股票配對迷因幣；他舉鏈上 AMC 價格是實際股價 35 倍為例。

paraphrase.en: A LONG co-founder replies that a rising DEX price is not a squeeze on the real stock: minting stops for the weekend, and whoever can mint at the open will arbitrage it away.
paraphrase.zh: LONG 共同創辦人回應：DEX 上的價格上漲不等於真實股票被軋空；週末停止鑄造，開盤時能鑄造的人會把價差套利掉。

what.en: Minting is paused over the weekend
what.zh: 週末暫停鑄造

onchain.value: no HIMS mint from Fri 15:53:48 to Mon 00:43:30 UTC

note.en: The chain shows no mint for the whole weekend, only two Friday redemptions.
note.zh: 鏈上整個週末沒有任何鑄造，只有週五兩筆贖回。

paraphrase.en: About an hour before the dollar pool ran dry, a widely followed account says BONER squeezing HIMS shorts would be the wildest thing he has seen in crypto.
paraphrase.zh: 美元池見底前約一小時，一個追蹤者眾多的帳號說，若 BONER 真的軋到 HIMS 空頭，會是他在加密圈見過最誇張的事。

paraphrase.en: An account named RoaringKitty (not confirmed as the GameStop-era trader) asks whether HIMS is really being short-squeezed on Robinhood Chain, pointing to the BONER chart, 13 seconds before the dollar pool sold its last HIMS.
paraphrase.zh: 一個名為 RoaringKitty 的帳號（未確認是 GameStop 時期那位交易員）指著 BONER 走勢問：HIMS 真的在 Robinhood Chain 上被軋空了嗎？13 秒後美元池賣出最後一顆 HIMS。

what.zh: HIMS 在鏈上被擠壓（提問）

onchain.value: 29.7 HIMS left and 54.21 USDG (+88%) at 23:24; zero HIMS at 23:24:59

note.en: The token's on-chain float was being squeezed, but nothing on-chain shows shorts in the listed stock being forced to cover.
note.zh: 被擠壓的是代幣在鏈上的流通量；鏈上看不到任何上市股票的空頭被迫回補。

paraphrase.en: About a minute after the dollar pool emptied, the BONER project account posts a size joke and its 'hard money' tagline. It does not mention the drained pool or the price.
paraphrase.zh: 美元池被買空約一分鐘後，BONER 專案帳號貼出一則尺寸笑話和「hard money」口號，沒有提到池子被抽乾，也沒提價格。

paraphrase.en: Reports that BONER buying has pushed on-chain HIMS above $50, against a Friday close he gives as $28.88.
paraphrase.zh: 回報 BONER 的買盤已把鏈上 HIMS 推過 50 美元；他引用的週五收盤價是 28.88 美元。

what.zh: 鏈上 HIMS 價格

note.en: Minute closes first went above 50 at 23:24, eleven minutes earlier, and stayed mostly above it (brief dips to 44–47 at 23:26 and 23:33); a spike had first touched 55.7 at 22:33. His $28.88 close differs slightly from the $28.84 used by DeFiPrime.
note.zh: 分鐘收盤在 23:24 首次突破 50（發文前十一分鐘），之後大多維持在 50 以上（23:26 與 23:33 短暫跌到 44–47）；更早在 22:33 曾有一次短暫衝到 55.7。他給的收盤價 28.88 與 DeFiPrime 採用的 28.84 略有差異。

paraphrase.en: Notes that the best-priced HIMS swap now often skips the dollar pool and hops through BONER, the AI memecoin and WETH to reach USDG.
paraphrase.zh: 指出現在 HIMS 的最佳兌換路徑常常不走美元池，而是經 BONER、AI 迷因幣與 WETH 繞到 USDG。

what.en: Direct dollar pool no longer the best route
what.zh: 直接走美元池已不是最佳路徑

note.en: With the dollar pool nearly empty, routers went around it. The first Monday arbitrages (00:43:37) used the same BONER→AI path.
note.zh: 美元池幾乎見底，路由器改走旁路；週一第一批套利（00:43:37）走的也是 BONER→AI 這條路。

paraphrase.en: Replying to the Hims & Hers CEO, a user describes BONER as a ~$13M memecoin paired with tokenized HIMS and says each purchase makes Robinhood buy and mint more HIMS.
paraphrase.zh: 一位用戶回覆 Hims & Hers 執行長，形容 BONER 是市值約 1,300 萬美元、與代幣化 HIMS 配對的迷因幣，並說每筆買單都會讓 Robinhood 買股並鑄造更多 HIMS。

what.zh: BONER 市值

note.en: Within 8%; it swung between about $7.5M and $17.5M during that hour.
note.zh: 誤差 8% 以內；那一小時市值在約 750 萬到 1,750 萬美元之間擺盪。

what.zh: 每筆買單都會觸發鑄造

note.en: No HIMS was minted all weekend; supply stayed at 15,227 until the issuer window reopened.
note.zh: 整個週末沒有鑄造任何 HIMS；供給停在 15,227 顆，直到發行方窗口重開。

paraphrase.en: Says BONER is already breaking on-chain HIMS and that Robinhood will need to supply more shares, adding that a real squeeze is not far-fetched.
paraphrase.zh: 說 BONER 已經把鏈上 HIMS 買到失靈，Robinhood 得補更多股份，還說真正的軋空並非天方夜譚。

what.zh: 鏈上 HIMS 幾近耗盡

onchain.value: 49.3 HIMS in the dollar pool; supply 15,227

note.en: Supply could not grow until the first mint at 00:43:30.
note.zh: 在 00:43:30 首筆鑄造之前，供給無法增加。

paraphrase.en: The thread that set the numbers: BONER's pool held about 12,284 of ~15,227 HIMS (81%), the dollar pool ~92 HIMS against $135K, HIMS ~$39 (+37%). He calls it a float squeeze, not a short squeeze.
paraphrase.zh: 定調數字的貼文：BONER 池約有 12,284 顆 HIMS，佔約 15,227 顆的 81%；美元池只剩約 92 顆 HIMS 對 13.5 萬 USDG；HIMS 約 39 美元（+37%）。他稱之為流通量擠壓，而非軋空。

what.zh: BONER 池內 HIMS

note.en: Within 1%.
note.zh: 誤差 1% 以內。

what.zh: 佔鏈上供給比例

note.en: Supply was fixed at 15,227 all weekend.
note.zh: 整個週末供給固定在 15,227 顆。

what.zh: 美元池：HIMS 對 USDG

note.en: Exact match at Mon 00:03.
note.zh: 與週一 00:03 完全吻合。

what.zh: HIMS 價格與溢價

note.en: All four figures fit 00:03, ten minutes before the post. By 00:13 the price was 33.89, and it later spiked again.
note.zh: 四個數字都對應 00:03，也就是發文前十分鐘；到 00:13 價格已是 33.89，之後又再衝高一次。

paraphrase.en: Pushes back under that thread: if arbitrageurs can get in, whoever bought at these prices loses heavily; if they cannot, it is just one memecoin trading against another.
paraphrase.zh: 在那串貼文底下唱反調：套利者一旦能進場，在這個價位買進的人會大賠；如果進不來，那就只是一個迷因幣在跟另一個迷因幣交易。

what.en: Arbitrage will pull the price back
what.zh: 套利會把價格拉回

note.en: Once minting resumed, the premium fell from about 85% to 1.6% in 75 minutes.
note.zh: 恢復鑄造後，溢價在 75 分鐘內從約 85% 降到 1.6%。

paraphrase.en: Predicts the gap closes the moment whoever holds minting rights mints and sells: the minter profits and weekend buyers are left holding. The first mint lands 58 s later; Sammy disputes the idea a few minutes after that.
paraphrase.zh: 預言價差會在握有鑄造權的一方鑄造並賣出時被吃掉：鑄造者賺錢，週末買家被套。58 秒後首筆鑄造上鏈；幾分鐘後 Sammy 回說機制不是這樣。

what.en: Whoever can mint mints and sells into the gap
what.zh: 握有鑄造權的一方鑄造後賣進價差

note.en: The largest one-swap price drop came 3 min 48 s after the mint; the premium was about 12% by 00:55.
note.zh: 單筆跌幅最大的一筆賣出出現在鑄造後 3 分 48 秒；到 00:55 溢價約剩 12%。

paraphrase.en: Points out that the 37% premium was quoted off a pool left with ~92 HIMS (about $3.6K) against $135K of USDG, nearly all dollars, and asks how fast minting works.
paraphrase.zh: 指出所謂 37% 溢價，是從只剩約 92 顆 HIMS（約 3,600 美元）對上 13.5 萬 USDG、幾乎只剩美元的池子報出來的，並問開盤後鑄造要多久。

what.zh: 美元池：HIMS 對 USDG

note.en: Right for 00:03. By the time of the post, minting had begun and the pool held about 460 HIMS.
note.zh: 對 00:03 而言正確；發文時已開始鑄造，池內約有 460 顆 HIMS。

paraphrase.en: Argues crypto Twitter has it backwards: the tokens are thinly traded IOUs, so buyers were paying above NAV rather than squeezing the stock, and the poor tracking is a bad sign.
paraphrase.zh: 認為加密推特搞錯了：這些代幣是交易清淡的借據，買家付的是高於淨值的價格，並不是在軋空股票；追蹤不準本身就是壞訊號。

what.en: Buyers paid a premium over NAV
what.zh: 買家付出高於淨值的溢價

note.en: The premium existed only on-chain; the replay has no data on the NYSE stock.
note.zh: 溢價只存在於鏈上；重播資料不含紐約證交所的股票。

paraphrase.en: Tells BONER buyers hoping for a Monday squeeze that the pool holds only about $500K of HIMS against a $6.7B company, so a real squeeze needs far bigger numbers.
paraphrase.zh: 提醒期待週一軋空的 BONER 買家：池裡的 HIMS 只值約 50 萬美元，對上市值 67 億美元的公司，要真正軋空規模得大上許多。

what.en: HIMS value in the BONER pool
what.zh: BONER 池內 HIMS 價值

note.en: Exact at 02:34.
note.zh: 與 02:34 的數字完全吻合。

paraphrase.en: Reports that more HIMS is being minted on-chain right now after BONER took the whole pool, linking a live tracker; a repost two minutes later says 'entire supply' instead.
paraphrase.zh: 回報 BONER 把池子吃光之後，鏈上正在鑄造更多 HIMS，並附上即時追蹤頁；兩分鐘後的重貼版改稱「全部供給」。

what.zh: 正在鑄造 HIMS

note.en: Minting continued: 29,765 by 03:39.
note.zh: 鑄造持續進行：03:39 已達 29,765 顆。

what.en: BONER took the entire pool / supply
what.zh: BONER 吃掉整個池子／全部供給

onchain.value: dollar pool at zero 23:24:59; BONER pool max 84.6% of supply

note.en: True of the dollar pool; the 'entire supply' wording overstates it.
note.zh: 對美元池而言成立；「全部供給」的說法則誇大了。

paraphrase.en: Answering a question, says the HIMS token has stayed close to its reference price apart from one short blip.
paraphrase.zh: 回答提問時說，除了一次短暫失控，HIMS 代幣大致貼著參考價。

what.zh: HIMS 回到淨值附近

note.en: The 'blip' was the weekend spike, with minute closes up to 71.23 on Sunday night.
note.zh: 所謂「短暫失控」就是週末那波暴衝，週日晚間分鐘收盤最高到 71.23。

paraphrase.en: Chinese explainer: BONER drained 81% of on-chain HIMS, lifting it from $28.84 to $39 while Wall Street was shut; an on-chain float squeeze, not a NYSE one. Cites supply rising to 29,765.
paraphrase.zh: 中文解說：BONER 抽走鏈上 81% 的 HIMS，趁華爾街休市把價格從 28.84 推到 39 美元；作者強調這是鏈上流通量擠壓，不是紐約證交所的軋空，並引用供給已增至 29,765 顆。

what.zh: 鑄造後的 HIMS 供給

note.en: Exact five minutes before the post, so the author was reading a live tracker.
note.zh: 與發文前五分鐘的鏈上數字完全相同，作者應是在看即時追蹤頁。

note.en: Repeats the 00:03 snapshot; at posting time the premium was about 1%.
note.zh: 沿用 00:03 的快照；發文當下溢價已只剩約 1%。

paraphrase.en: Quoting that thread, sets roughly $400K of tokenized weekend float against about $424M of HIMS stock traded on Friday, and doubts it ends well for on-chain buyers.
paraphrase.zh: 引用那串貼文，拿週末約 40 萬美元的代幣化流通量，對比週五約 4.24 億美元的 HIMS 股票成交額，並懷疑鏈上買家會有好下場。

what.zh: 週末流通量的價值

note.en: Supply was fixed all weekend.
note.zh: 整個週末供給固定。

what.zh: 週五紐約證交所成交額

note.en: Not an on-chain figure.
note.zh: 這不是鏈上數據。

paraphrase.en: The source write-up's own post: BONER absorbed about 86% of the tokenized HIMS float, on-chain HIMS reached $61 against a $28.84 close (+112%), and issuer mints ended it within two hours.
paraphrase.zh: 本頁主要資料來源 DeFiPrime 的貼文：BONER 吸走約 86% 的代幣化 HIMS 流通量，鏈上 HIMS 衝到 61 美元，對比收盤 28.84（+112%），發行方鑄造後兩小時內結束。

what.zh: BONER 吸走的流通量

note.en: Uncollected fees would add the rest.
note.zh: 其餘差距應是尚未領取的手續費。

what.zh: 鏈上價格達到

note.en: A trade at 23:36:13, not the peak: the highest post-swap price was 124.70 and the top minute close 71.23.
note.zh: 這是 23:36:13 的一筆成交，不是高點：成交後最高池價是 124.70，分鐘收盤最高 71.23。

what.en: Mints ended it within two hours
what.zh: 鑄造後兩小時內結束

onchain.value: +1.6% at 01:59, 75 min after the first mint

paraphrase.en: A 48-hour roundup seen about 207K times: wallets holding tokenized stocks rose 46% in three days, and 'float squeezes' are turning into a weekend problem as small stock tokens get targeted.
paraphrase.zh: 約 20.7 萬次瀏覽的 48 小時整理：持有代幣化股票的錢包三天增加 46%；隨著小型股代幣成為目標，「流通量擠壓」正變成週末的固定亂象。

paraphrase.en: The Defiant headlines a short-squeeze attempt, says BONER cornered half the tokenized HIMS, and reports a $132.64 print on $39,000 of volume, noting Ondo's larger HIMS token stayed near $29.
paraphrase.zh: The Defiant 以「軋空」為標題，說 BONER 囤了一半的代幣化 HIMS，並報導在 3.9 萬美元成交量下出現 132.64 美元的價格；同時指出 Ondo 流通量更大的 HIMS 代幣一直在 29 美元附近。

what.zh: 鏈上 HIMS 最高價

onchain.value: 124.70 highest post-swap price (23:28:42 UTC); 122.75 highest trade price; 71.23 top minute close (23:31); 133.35 in a small 50%-fee pool (23:30:46, 0.52 HIMS)

note.en: No swap in the two main dollar pools traded at 132.x. The highest post-swap price was 124.70 (that 12.69 HIMS buy paid 71.25 on average), and the highest price any trade executed at was 122.75. Across all 55 USDG/HIMS pools, the only higher trade was a 0.52 HIMS router leg into a small 50%-fee pool at 133.35 (23:30:46), which a per-trade chart could show.
note.zh: 兩個主要美元池都沒有 132 美元左右的成交。成交後最高池價是 124.70（那筆買進 12.69 顆，平均每顆只付 71.25），單筆成交均價最高是 122.75。在全部 55 個 USDG/HIMS 池中，唯一更高的成交是一筆路由分單經過一個 50% 手續費小池，在 23:30:46 以每顆 133.35 買到 0.52 顆；逐筆成交圖表可能會顯示這類價格。

what.en: Half of tokenized HIMS in BONER
what.zh: BONER 持有一半代幣化 HIMS

note.en: The share fell from ~85% as supply grew.
note.zh: 隨供給增加，比例已從約 85% 降下來。

what.zh: Ondo 的 HIMS 代幣維持在 29 美元附近

note.en: A different token on another chain; not in our replay.
note.zh: 這是另一條鏈上的不同代幣，不在我們的重播範圍。

paraphrase.en: Corrects The Defiant: this was a float squeeze, not a short squeeze, since limited supply in the meme pool inflated only the on-chain price; a real short squeeze needs more liquidity on-chain than off.
paraphrase.zh: 糾正 The Defiant：這是流通量擠壓而非軋空，只是迷因池裡的供給有限，把鏈上價格墊高；要真正軋空，得等鏈上流動性比鏈下還多。

paraphrase.en: Chinese explainer (~71K views) calls it GameStop 2.0: about 81% of ~15,200 on-chain HIMS sat in BONER pools, the price topped $61.15, and after the first 1,000 new HIMS it normalised in about two hours.
paraphrase.zh: 約 7.1 萬次瀏覽的中文解說稱之為 GameStop 2.0：鏈上約 1.52 萬顆 HIMS 有約 81% 在 BONER 池，最高 61.15 美元；首批 1,000 顆新 HIMS 鑄出後，約兩小時回到正常。

what.zh: 最高價

onchain.value: 61.15 (swap at 23:36:13); top minute close 71.23 (23:31); highest post-swap price 124.70 (23:28:42)

note.en: Traded at 61.15 (23:36:13), but minute closes reached 71.23 at 23:31 and the post-swap price 124.70 at 23:28:42.

what.zh: 首批鑄造 1,000 顆，約兩小時恢復正常

paraphrase.en: A daily newsletter post (88K views) says BONER took about 81% of tokenized HIMS and wicked its price above $120, over 4x its value, because market makers could not mint on the weekend.
paraphrase.zh: 一份每日電子報的貼文（8.8 萬次瀏覽）說 BONER 拿走約 81% 的代幣化 HIMS，週末造市商無法鑄造，價格一度插針到 120 美元以上、超過實際價值 4 倍。

what.zh: 價格插針到 120 美元以上（超過 4 倍）

onchain.value: 124.70 after one swap at 23:28:42 (4.3x); a 0.016 HIMS sale at 122.75 at 23:28:43

note.en: A post-swap price on thin liquidity (12.69 HIMS bought for 904 USDG, 71.25 on average); a 0.016 HIMS sale a second later executed at 122.75, so '>$120' holds as a trade too. Minute closes peaked at 71.23 (2.5x).

findings.en: X watched it happen, mostly as a joke. The first post asking whether HIMS was being squeezed came 13 seconds before the dollar pool sold its last HIMS (23:24:59 UTC); by 23:39 a user saw routers going around the nearly empty pool via BONER and AI. The first numbers arrived at 00:13 and match the chain at 00:03, all within about 1%.
findings.zh: X 上的人是即時看著它發生的，只是多半當成笑話。第一則問 HIMS 是否被擠壓的貼文，比美元池賣出最後一顆 HIMS（23:24:59 UTC）早了 13 秒；23:39 已有用戶發現路由器改走 BONER 與 AI，繞過幾乎見底的池子。第一批數字在 00:13 出現，和鏈上 00:03 的狀態相比，誤差都在約 1% 以內。

findings.en: The mechanism was spelled out before and during the event. In the two hours before the buying began, a trader warned against off-hours stock pairs and a LONG co-founder said minting was closed for the weekend. At 00:42 a reply predicted that whoever can mint would mint and sell into the gap; the first mint landed under a minute later, and the sharpest single-swap price drop (−37.5%, a 120 HIMS sale) came 3 min 48 s after that.
findings.zh: 機制在事前與事中都有人講清楚了。買盤開始前的兩小時內，有交易員警告別在休市時段碰股票配對，LONG 共同創辦人也說週末暫停鑄造。00:42 有則回覆預言握有鑄造權的一方會鑄造後賣進價差；不到一分鐘後首筆鑄造上鏈，3 分 48 秒後出現單筆跌幅最大的一筆賣出（賣出 120 顆，池價跌 37.5%）。

findings.en: Nobody official spoke. From 28 Aug to 10 Sep we found no post about HIMS or BONER from Robinhood, its executives or Hims & Hers corporate accounts, and the BONER account joked through the drain. The only company-side signal is that the Hims & Hers CEO follows the BONER account (first noticed 6 Sep, confirmed 25 Sep).
findings.zh: 沒有任何官方表態。8 月 28 日到 9 月 10 日，我們找不到 Robinhood、其高層或 Hims & Hers 公司帳號談 HIMS 或 BONER 的貼文；BONER 帳號在池子被抽乾時還在開玩笑。公司端唯一的訊號，是 Hims & Hers 執行長追蹤了 BONER 帳號（9 月 6 日首次被發現，9 月 25 日確認）。

findings.en: 'Float squeeze' comes from the 00:13 thread, whose author later corrected The Defiant's short-squeeze headline, and DeFiPrime and OKX Ventures took it up. 'Short squeeze' still dominated: on 31 Aug and 1 Sep, posts about the event used it 55 times against 29 for 'float squeeze'.
findings.zh: 「流通量擠壓」（float squeeze）一詞出自 00:13 那串貼文，作者後來還糾正了 The Defiant 用「軋空」下的標題，DeFiPrime 與 OKX Ventures 也沿用這個說法。但「軋空」仍然更常見：8 月 31 日與 9 月 1 日談這起事件的貼文用了 55 次「軋空」，「流通量擠壓」只有 29 次。

findings.en: Posts that quote a moment agree with the chain: 81%, 92 HIMS against $135K, $39, $61.15, $500K and 29,765 tokens all match to the minute. The $132.64 peak, first reported by The Defiant about 19 hours later, spread to nearly 80 posts in 11 languages, including a BingX referral template. No swap in the two main dollar pools traded near 132: the highest post-swap price was 124.70, left by a 12.69 HIMS buy that paid 71.25 on average, and the only higher trade was a 0.52 HIMS router leg through a small 50%-fee pool at 133.35. 81% (Mon 00:03) and 86% (DeFiPrime; our peak is 84.6% at 00:29, and their count may include fees) describe the same fixed 15,227 supply at different moments; later figures such as 53% came after the mints, when about 58.7K HIMS existed (Monday evening UTC).
findings.zh: 引用特定時刻的貼文，數字都和鏈上一致：81%、92 顆 HIMS 對 13.5 萬美元、39 美元、61.15 美元、50 萬美元、29,765 顆，全都對得上分鐘資料。132.64 美元的高點則是 The Defiant 在約 19 小時後首先報導，之後擴散到近 80 則、11 種語言的貼文，其中包括一套 BingX 推薦連結模板；但兩個主要美元池都沒有 132 美元左右的成交：成交後的最高池價是 124.70，來自一筆買進 12.69 顆、平均每顆只付 71.25 的交易；唯一更高的成交，是一筆路由分單經過一個 50% 手續費小池的 0.52 顆，每顆 133.35。81%（週一 00:03）與 86%（DeFiPrime；我們的最高值是 00:29 的 84.6%，他們的數字可能含手續費）是同一個固定 15,227 顆供給在不同時刻的比例；53% 等較晚的數字則出現在增發之後，當時（週一晚間 UTC）供給已約 5.87 萬顆。

findings.en: Some confusion came from X itself. In 34 posts up to 31 Aug 02:54 UTC, including the main thread, the text X returns links the $BONER cashtag to a Solana token address rather than the Robinhood Chain contract. A reply at 23:47 said the chart pointed to the wrong coin, and a podcast promo on 2 Sep called BONER a Solana memecoin.
findings.zh: 部分混淆來自 X 本身：在 8 月 31 日 02:54 UTC 之前的 34 則貼文裡（包括那串主貼文），X 回傳的文字把 $BONER 這個 cashtag 連到一個 Solana 代幣地址，而不是 Robinhood Chain 上的合約。23:47 有則回覆指出圖表連到錯的幣，9 月 2 日的 Podcast 預告也把 BONER 說成 Solana 迷因幣。

limits.en: Search depth: X search returned nothing for 31 Aug 12:34 UTC to 1 Sep 00:00 (the Monday US session), so the strip's drop after 12:34 is a search gap, not a lull. 28 Aug before 13:20 hit its item cap, and weeks after 11 Sep are only sampled.
limits.zh: 搜尋深度：X 搜尋在 8 月 31 日 12:34 UTC 到 9 月 1 日 00:00（週一美股交易時段）完全沒有回傳結果，所以密度條在 12:34 之後的下降是搜尋缺口，不是討論變少；8 月 28 日 13:20 之前的時段觸及筆數上限；9 月 11 日之後只做了抽樣。

limits.en: The hourly strip counts posts that name HIMS or BONER plus replies inside the 67 threads we expanded, so hours around those threads count more fully than quiet ones.
limits.zh: 每小時密度條計入提到 HIMS 或 BONER 的貼文，以及我們展開的 67 個串文底下的回覆，因此那些串文附近的時段會比冷清時段收得更完整。

limits.en: Bots and campaigns: 22 copies of a BingX referral template, token-deploy bots and shill replies are in the raw data. Tiers come from keyword rules plus a hand review, so some posts will be misclassified.
limits.zh: 機器人與行銷活動：原始資料裡有 22 則 BingX 推薦連結模板、自動發幣機器人與喊單回覆。分類依關鍵字規則加人工檢查，仍難免有誤判。

limits.en: Deleted, protected and suspended posts cannot be seen. View, like and follower counts are as of 25–26 Sep 2026.
limits.zh: 已刪除、設為私密或被停權的貼文無法看到。瀏覽數、按讚數與追蹤者數以 2026 年 9 月 25–26 日為準。

limits.en: Languages: English dominates. Searches used HIMS/BONER plus local terms in 17 other languages, so posts that name the coin only in images or by nicknames are missed.
limits.zh: 語言：以英文為主。搜尋使用 HIMS／BONER 加上另外 17 種語言的在地用詞，只在圖片裡或用暱稱提到這個幣的貼文會被漏掉。

limits.en: Identity: handles are shown only for organisations and accounts with at least 1,000 followers. The handle RoaringKitty is shown as posted; nothing confirms it belongs to the GameStop-era trader.
limits.zh: 身分：只有機構與追蹤者至少 1,000 人的帳號才顯示帳號名稱。RoaringKitty 這個帳號名稱照原樣呈現，沒有證據顯示它屬於 GameStop 時期那位交易員。
